claims.text: The starting CoCrFeNi alloy is homogeneous and single-phase.
The starting CoCrFeNi alloy contains no preexisting self-lubricating phases.
A combination of heat treatment and compositional adjustment can precipitate finely dispersed nanoparticles in CoCrFeNi.
The induced nanoparticles will be capable of forming a lubricious tribofilm during sliding.
The intervention will produce uniformly distributed nanoprecipitates along grain boundaries and at the sliding interface.
At lower temperatures, the nanoprecipitates will act as a solid lubricant and reduce metal-to-metal contact.
The nanoprecipitates will remain thermally stable as temperature increases toward 800 °C.
At elevated temperature, the nanoprecipitates will promote formation of a thermally robust, lubricious tribofilm.
Increasing temperature can increase lattice disorder and thereby increase tangential force and coefficient of friction.
Dislocation movement contributes to the temperature-induced increase in tangential force.
The tribofilm will suppress the increase in tangential force and protect the alloy against wear.
Unmodified CoCrFeNi tends to exhibit increased friction at elevated temperatures because of increasing microstructural or lattice disorder.
Unmodified CoCrFeNi tends to exhibit increased wear at elevated temperatures because of increasing microstructural disorder.
Dislocation density in the baseline alloy decreases at elevated temperature and contributes to deteriorating tribological performance.
The modified alloy will maintain a lower and more consistent coefficient of friction than unmodified CoCrFeNi from room temperature to 800 °C.
The modified alloy will maintain a lower and more consistent wear rate than unmodified CoCrFeNi from room temperature to 800 °C.
Excessive load can mechanically break down the beneficial tribofilm and negate the intervention's advantage.
Conditions that accelerate nanoparticle coarsening can negate the intervention's advantage.
The intervention is effective only in oxidation environments that support rather than degrade the tribofilm.
